name: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
note: Indian state-owned insurer listed on NSE/BSE since 2022. Per its own shareholding pattern (as on 1 June 2026, licindia.in), its promoter is 'President of India' (Central Government) with 96.50% of the shares. Per Tech Mahindra's shareholding pattern for the quarter ended 31 December 2025, LIC held 11.49% of Tech Mahindra's shares.
